## Past teaching

### Economics, preparation for the *Agrégation* (M2)

**ENS Paris-Saclay**, 2018–2020

Lead instructor for the economics track of the *Agrégation d'économie-gestion* preparation. Weekly 3-hour lectures (31 sessions per year) combining theoretical content and contemporary case studies, complemented by 5 written exams (5h essays) and 3 oral exams (1h presentations). Students conducted a continuous press review throughout the year.

<details>

<summary>Course syllabus (14 chapters)</summary>

I personally taught 13 of the 14 chapters.

-   Chapter 1 — Classical microeconomic theory
-   Chapter 2 — Challenges to classical microeconomic theory
-   Chapter 3 — Consumption, saving, investment
-   Chapter 4 — International trade
-   Chapter 5 — International monetary and financial systems *(by [Samuel Ligonnière](https://samuelligonniere.com/))*
-   Chapter 6 — Growth and development
-   Chapter 7 — Effectiveness and efficiency of the State and institutions
-   Chapter 8 — The European Union
-   Chapter 9 — Short-term economic policies
-   Chapter 10 — Employment and unemployment
-   Chapter 11 — Competition policy
-   Chapter 12 — Competitiveness policies
-   Chapter 13 — Social protection and demography
-   Chapter 14 — Taxation, social justice, and inequalities

**Methodology sessions**: written and oral exam techniques in economics

**Invited lectures**: environmental economics, economics of education, risk, insurance and asymmetric information

</details>

### Management control, preparation for the *Agrégation* (M2)

**ENS Paris-Saclay**, 2015–2018

Part of a wider preparation track covering accounting, corporate finance, and management control. Management control was delivered through 12 three-hour lectures per year.

<details>

<summary>Course syllabus (12 chapters)</summary>

-   Introduction — Stakes of management control
-   Chapter 1-A — Full costing: the cost center method
-   Chapter 1-B — Full costing: activity-based costing
-   Chapter 2 — Partial costing
-   Chapter 3 — Procurement management
-   Chapter 4 — Sales forecasting techniques
-   Chapter 5 — Budgeting and investment decisions
-   Chapter 6 — Production budget
-   Chapter 7 — Human resources management
-   Chapter 8 — Variance analysis
-   Chapter 9 — Target costing
-   Chapter 10 — Responsibility centers and internal transfer pricing
-   Chapter 11 — Project management
-   Chapter 12 — Dashboards and reporting

</details>
